subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Space and shape: 3D objects, 2D shapes, position and symmetry (integrated with data handling)
source.subtopic: Symmetry: recognise and draw a line of symmetry in 2D geometrical and non-geometrical shapes

show.line: Fold the butterfly down the middle. Both sides match! That fold line is a line of symmetry.

rounds.prompt: Which picture has a line of symmetry? Both sides match.
rounds.praise: Yes! Fold the heart and both sides match.

rounds.prompt: Which line cuts the square into two matching halves?
rounds.praise: Yes! The line through the middle.

rounds.prompt: Look at this face. Is it the same on both sides? Say yes or no.
Which half finishes the picture of the ladybird?
Does it have a line of symmetry? Put each one in its group.
Which letter shape has a line of symmetry down the middle?
rounds.praise: Yes! Fold it down the middle and the sides match.

hints: Imagine folding the picture. Do the two sides sit exactly on top of each other?
A line of symmetry goes right through the middle.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will draw the line of symmetry on the heart.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Here is my line, across the top!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! The two parts do not match. The line goes down the middle.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's fold it together. Down the middle, and both sides match!

parent_line: Can recognise a line of symmetry in shapes and pictures.
